This is what learning looks like when AI does the teaching
Why this AI education demo should make every school district nervous
The AI learning tool that gives early users a head start most students never get
caption:
AI is doing something one classroom teacher simply cannot: teaching each student like they are the only one in the room.

Private tutoring has always produced better outcomes. The cost kept most students from it. What tools like this show is an AI that adapts in real time, available on any device, at any hour, in any subject. The student is no longer pacing themselves to a class of thirty.

Students already using tools like this are pulling ahead. The gap between what someone can afford and what they can actually learn is closing fast.
